regions.merged_text: I am sending you back the relic you chose as also the little particles of Fr. Stephen's habit. They are pieces left over from about ten or more years ago, when Fr. Capistran was Guardian and we had the Felician Sisters mount those others, now I presume, about all gone. I think they would be glad to finish that work. Some of their numbers are quite enthusiastic about Fr. Stephen.
